verdict.rationale: Phaser ships its own AI tooling (Phaser Editor and a hosted Game Agent), so asking whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair question. However, the evidence only shows Phaser acting as an MCP server, exposing 40+ tools to Claude Desktop, Cursor and Copilot. Nothing documents Phaser, its Editor or its Game Agent connecting to third-party MCP servers as a client, and server-side capability does not transfer to this story.
